purpose: Scan the full Git history for exposed credentials, publish the rotation register, and leave behind a repeatable scanner rather than a one-off claim.
requiredInvariants: A secret value must never be printed; findings carry class, location and fingerprint only.
The allowlist must be pinned by blob SHA, never by path, so changed content is reported again.
Every allowlist entry must record why the value is not a credential and when it was reviewed.
Absence of matches must never be presented as absolute proof; coverage limits must be stated.
Git history must not be rewritten in this slice.
No product code, dependency, lockfile or production configuration may change.
Merge and CI success are not REG.RU production deployment evidence.
acceptance: The scanner detects all seven high-confidence credential classes and private key material with a base64 body.
The scanner does not flag the project's own defensive regexes or a shell case arm.
The scanner does not flag connection strings aimed at localhost or reserved domains, but does flag a routable one.
Findings never contain the secret value.
Full-history scan over 25976 blobs reports zero findings with one reviewed allowlist entry.
The tree scan runs in CI.
The concurrent-scope guard accepts exactly the six authorized paths.
